codeReview.summary: Clean, well-scoped implementation of milestone marker recognition in the plan parser. The worker followed TDD correctly: wrote 23 tests first (red phase), then implemented minimal code to pass them (green phase). The regex MILESTONE_RE = /^## Milestone: (.+)$/ is properly strict — only matches exact H2 format with capital M, colon-space separator, and at least one character after the space. The parser correctly tracks currentMilestone scope, flushes in-progress phases at milestone boundaries, and passes the milestone through PlanFileProvider. Conditional assignment (only setting milestone when defined) keeps serialized output clean. All 8 strict format negative tests ensure no false positives. Backward compatibility is verified against existing fixtures. No bugs, edge case gaps, or error states found.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission AGENTS.md architecture notes list 'src/state/reader.ts' as the key file for milestone parsing, but the actual implementation lives in 'src/controller/plan-parser.ts'. The reader.ts file handles state file parsing, not plan content parsing. This mismatch could confuse future workers assigned milestone-related features.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Feature description says 'Key files: src/state/reader.ts (plan parsing)' but plan parsing is in src/controller/plan-parser.ts. The import in plan-parser.ts line 11 shows reader.ts is only imported for its ParsedStateFile type.

summary: The milestone-plan-markers feature is a clean, well-tested implementation. It adds milestone marker recognition (## Milestone: <name>) to the plan parser with proper scope tracking, strict format enforcement (8 negative test cases), backward compatibility with existing plans, and PlanFileProvider passthrough. 23 new tests with 72 expect() calls cover all expected behaviors. The implementation is minimal and focused — only 3 source files modified with additive-only changes (new optional fields). All 3562 tests pass with clean typecheck. No blocking issues found.
